asked.round: QNT, BNB and WETH fix round
asked.do: `CalleeKeeps` restates the conclusion of `solvent_withdraw` and is too loose (no gas bound, callee code not pinned). (a) Restate it locally, about the one message withdraw's CALL sends, with the gas the CALL really gives (withdraw uses a transfer: 2300 stipend, value > 0; read the exact gas from the bytes) and discharge it for the real runner for a no-code caller, a STOP contract and a contract that only accepts ether. (b) Stretch goal, the real reentrancy theorem with no callee assumption: a message that runs with at most the stipend gas cannot change any storage (SSTORE needs more than 2300 gas left since Istanbul) and cannot lower WETH's ether balance, whatever code it runs, including calls back into WETH. This needs an induction over EthLib's execution; reuse EthLib / upstream lemmas on gas monotonicity and stuck SSTORE (Evm/Stuck.lean, Logic/LessGas, NoAbort). If (b) is blocked after 3 distinct approaches, stop on it and report precisely what is missing; (a) must still be done.

fix_3a.what: The loose assumption CalleeKeeps is gone. The new assumption CalleeQuiet is about the one message that the CALL of this run of withdraw sends (CallSend: exact gas from the bytes, value wad, code, caller, target, and a sender frame whose state is the start state with the balance slot lowered). It says: no storage word of the contract changes and its ether falls by at most wad. It does not mention the invariant.

fix_3b.what: Real reentrancy theorem with no assumption on the callee code. A message that starts with at most 2300 gas changes no account and no storage word apart from the move of its own value, whatever its code and however deep its own calls go. Proved by strong induction on the gas of the message and fun_induction over EthLib's runFrame.

fix_rounds.summary: Fix 2 of the ten-token audit. The shared library TokenKit.Seq is written and builds; PEPE is the pilot and has the headline 'the supply invariant holds after any finite list of transactions, whoever calls and however deep' (supply_any_transactions) with every assumption named. The other 13 tokens are NOT edited: the recipe below is what later agents apply.

kit_theorems.runner_level (every fork): Seq.processMessage_good_local (Run.lean): a sane call from a good state whose run is Clean ends good, with or without error, whatever code it runs and whatever it sends at any depth, re-entry included. Seq.processCreateMessage_good_local for creations at another address, Seq.processRunner_good_local for the runner, Seq.runFrame_keeps_local for one frame of the token under the real runner.
kit_theorems.transaction (Dencun <= fork < Glamsterda: Seq.processTransaction_good (Tx.lean): EthLib's processTransaction takes a block state where L is good to one where L is good: gas purchase, EIP-7702 authorizations, first frame, the message (call or creation), refunds, fee, end-of-transaction deletions, incorporation into the block state.
kit_theorems.any finite list: Seq.Chain + Seq.chain_good; Seq.ChainCap + Seq.chainCap_good for tokens with a gas cap.
kit_theorems.base case: Seq.ZeroBase, Seq.good_of_zero, Seq.chain_from_zero; per invariant family Seq.zeroBase_supply / zeroBase_supply2 / zeroBase_supplyMask.
kit_theorems.fork_range_honest: Message level: every fork (plus the token's own bound). Transaction level: Fork.dencun <= fork < Fork.glamsterdam. Before Dencun the end-of-transaction deletion could remove L after a SELFDESTRUCT at L; the kit avoids a per-token 'never SELFDESTRUCT' proof by tracking Unmarked, which only EIP-6780 gives.

other_changes.option: a (transaction-level solvency proved with an induction written for an invariant that reads the balance)
other_changes.what_changed: Solvent C (sum of balanceOf <= ether of C) is not Seq.StorageOnly, so the kit does not apply as is. Three new generic files redo the kit's induction over EthLib's interpreter for an invariant with Bal.Mono (kept when the storage of L is the same and its ether is not lower): every step of a frame not at L keeps the storage of L and does not lower its ether (resU_step: value moves, SELFDESTRUCT, creations, reverts), then the message, transaction (gas purchase, authorizations, refunds, fee, deletions) and list levels. Weth/Tx.lean gives the WETH facts and the headlines; the frame at C uses solvent_preserved_process (stipend theorem, no assumption on the callee of withdraw).
theorems_added: plus 58 supporting lemmas in TxFrame, TxRun, TxChain (78 theorems in the four files)
